# `gcp.spanner.instance`

An isolated set of Cloud Spanner resources on which databases can be hosted.

It also defaults nodeCount to 1 when none of nodeCount, processingUnits or autoscalingConfig is set. THE BOUNDED GAP: write one of the three; Google's own error names it otherwise.
update_encoder (encoders/spanner_instance_update.go.tmpl) builds UpdateInstanceRequest{instance, fieldMask}; the generator detects that envelope and BuildMask emits the same leaf paths. decoder is Terraform's id bookkeeping; post_create is a 5 second sleep after an awaited operation; pre_update only skips a change to Terraform's force_destroy. pre_delete deletes every backup first, gated on force_destroy.
